_doc: Start cue of every shot (brief rev 10 shot list). 'Section|line|word' = the word's start; 'end:…' its end; 't:<s>' a master time; 'section:<name>' its start. Indices from 0 as in lyrics/as_sung.txt. A shot ends where the next starts. 'snap': move onto a band beat (see scripts/shot_times.py). 'insert_picture_frames': a one-frame insert that returns to the previous shot. 'card': key in config/cards.json, checked against the hold rule. 'end': 'hold' sets the shot's end from the card's hold rule instead of the next shot (may run past the music). 'chain': start where the previous card's hold ends.
